ctx.event: Event | (); on_event only. Not present in a live timer context.
ctx.state: CS2State; state AFTER the source payload, on_event only.
ctx.previous: CS2State | (); state BEFORE the payload, on_event only.
ctx.current_match: MatchContext | (); shared authoritative match observation, on_event only.
ctx.timer: Timer; live on_timer only. No current game snapshot is implicitly added.
ctx.source: Source map for CS2, string 'timer' for timers.
ctx.actor_type: Execution actor: script or explicit scheduler/operator actor.

ctx.meta.revision: Pinned live revision, or draft test revision metadata.
ctx.meta.execution_id: Execution UUID used for audit correlation.
ctx.meta.source: Original source map for CS2; timer source string for timer work.

ctx.timer.creating_revision: Immutable revision that created this job.
ctx.timer.host_action: Internal host action or (); not a user callback selector.

ctx.state.view: Observed viewed identity; can be spectator.
ctx.state.player: Player | (); only when player.steamid matches authoritative provider.steamid.

ctx.state.match.score: Score {ct, t}; side labels, not fixed roster identity.

ctx.state.round.completed_rounds: Completed game-round counter, incremented at end, or ().

ctx.state.player.weapons: Observed array<Weapon> | (); absence does not prove a dropped item.

round_stats.kills: Known local kills in this real round | ().
round_stats.headshot_kills: Known local headshot kills in this real round | ().

weapon.ammo: Ammo {clip, capacity, reserve}; each field can be ().

ammo.reserve: Reported reserve units | (); do not assume bullet units.

ctx.event.source_seq: Signed payload seq, same across events from one payload.
ctx.event.timestamp: Signed observation UTC timestamp; not exact game-event time.
ctx.event.reliability: RELIABLE: emitted from supported evidence; does not mean a complete match.
ctx.event.round: RoundState; event-specific extra fields are listed in Events.

ctx.current_match.rounds: Array of completed observed RoundRecords, capped at 256.
ctx.current_match.current_round: Latest observed RoundRecord | (); may be completed until next boundary.
ctx.current_match.partial: true if evidence gaps/incomplete replacement found; absent until necessary, test membership.
ctx.current_match.end_reason: game_over or observation_reset when ended; may be absent.
ctx.current_match.local_summary: LocalSummary | (); cumulative stats with per-field authoritative provenance. May be absent before evidence.

r.completed: bool; incomplete observation is not a completed game round.
r.started_at: First observed time in this round.
r.side_swap_before: Optional {before: Score, after: Score, seq} halftime relabel; not points.
r.events: Persisted event timeline under advanced inspection; omitted from execution snapshots.

r.player.kills: Known local round kills | (); zero is known zero.
r.player.health: Last observed local health, not guaranteed round-end health.
r.player.match_stats: Last-authoritative cumulative counters | (); not per-round assists.

local_summary.observed_at: Latest local authoritative cumulative observation time.
local_summary.final: true only when all retained known fields observed at game over. Otherwise last observed.

result.ok: bool; not a guarantee of completed trade.
result.validation: Optional explanation of dry-run checks not simulated.

user.login: Observed login; can be absent in user_stats without chat.
